title: Imizamo Yethu, Hout Bay (OR Tambo Rd, approx.): man, 34, shot dead, 7 Oct
summary: A 34-year-old man was killed in a shooting on OR Tambo Road, Imizamo Yethu, Hout Bay, at about 19:19 on Wednesday 7 October; Hout Bay police registered a murder case and made no arrests (Sentinel News, quoting police spo...
story: A 34-year-old man was killed in a shooting on OR Tambo Road, Imizamo Yethu, Hout Bay, at about 19:19 on Wednesday 7 October; Hout Bay police registered a murder case and made no arrests (Sentinel News, quoting police spokesperson Thembakazi Mpendukana).
location_note: OR Tambo Road, Imizamo Yethu (exact spot not given). The pin is on the road.

provenance.note: One report, based on the police statement.

facts.label: Deaths
facts.claim: One man, 34, died en route to medical facility.

sources.name: Thembakazi Mpendukana, SAPS
sources.quote: The 34-year-old male victim succumbed to his injuries on his way to a medical facility
